name: Grab
description: Held: you cannot act until the grabber is hurt enough, an ally frees you, or the grabber is Dazed, Stunned, Blinded or killed. Stonefoot and Huge are immune.
endsWhen: freed: the grabber has taken 10% of its max HP since the Grab, an ally uses Free Ally, the grabber is Dazed, Stunned, Blinded or killed, or the grabber’s role cap of turns passes (D-047)

effects.note: cannot act; targetable only by the grabber; Net and Cocoon are Grabs
